summary: Backend testing complete for ArenaHub. Wrote pytest suite covering public routes, auth, RBAC, competitions CRUD, free & paid registrations, teams draw, bracket generation, match scoring propagation, my-registrations, and CORS preflight. 20/20 tests pass after fixing one MongoDB _id serialization bug in POST /api/registrations.

minor.issue: Endpoint returned 500 (ObjectId not iterable) because motor's insert_one mutates dict with _id, which was then returned. Fixed by popping _id after insert.

action_items: Review other endpoints for similar _id-mutation risk after insert_one (currently create_type, create_competition already pop _id; registration was missing this).
Consider making seed-defaults truly idempotent by upsert-on-name rather than only checking count>0 (currently safe).

CORS is configured with allow_origin_regex='.*' AND allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; the preflight test passes because header echoes back, but real browsers may block cross-origin requests with credentials. Consider explicit allowed origins.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~740 lines; consider splitting routes into modules (auth, competitions, registrations, tournaments, payments, email).
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY has a hardcoded fallback 'sk_test_emergent' - safe but noisy.
get_current_user compares expires_at (parsed str) to now(tz-aware) - handled correctly with tzinfo replace.
In draw_teams, solos filter includes registrations with mode='dupla' that lack partner_name, correct fallback.
propagate_winner logic uses position parity for slot assignment - matches update_match handler; consistent.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True - RFC-noncompliant for browsers; recommend echoing specific Origin.
test_credentials: Sessions created directly in Mongo per /app/auth_testing.md. Admin uses email danieloliveira78@gmail.com. Owner test user tokens created inline in fixtures.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures create TEST_-prefixed competitions and admin/user session rows. Teardown removes competitions, registrations, teams, matches, users and sessions. Also seeds 4 solo confirmed registrations to test draw/bracket.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Run: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0 (must use -n 0 because module-scoped admin_ctx fixture races with parallel workers on the OWNER_EMAIL unique upsert). Stripe checkout is created against real test API and returns real checkout URL; no external UI completion is attempted. Payment status endpoint returns 'pending' initially.
rca of the issue: POST /api/registrations returned 500. RCA: motor's insert_one adds `_id: ObjectId` to the passed dict in-place. The function then returned `{'registration': reg, ...}` and FastAPI's jsonable_encoder failed on ObjectId. Fix: `reg.pop('_id', None)` after insert. Reproduction: POST /api/registrations with a valid session token to an existing free competition.
